result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): The two cards are nearly identical in layout. Both have about 24px of padding, right-aligned prices, a rule above a bold total, a teal full-width button and an underlined Change dates link with much less emphasis. A uses a tinted header band to set off the trip details, and B splits the date and time onto two lines above a rule; both group the content clearly. Both buttons render at about 50–51px tall, slightly over the 48px limit, and spacing can only be judged from the screenshots, where it looks consistent in both. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): The two cards are nearly identical: both have about 24 px of padding, right-aligned prices, a rule above a bold total, and a teal button about 50 px tall (just over the 48 px limit) with a quiet underlined Change dates link. B wins slightly on grouping because its date/time sits closer to the trip name and its tinted header band separates the details from the line items. A's gap between the trip name and the date is about the same as its line-item row spacing, so its groups are a little weaker. Item 4 can't be checked from screenshots, so both scores there are estimates based on how even the spacing looks.
